title: Evidence: Credenza Not Received at Office

attachments.platform_description: Photos dated January 22 showing the loading dock area empty. The dock is an open area accessible from the building's rear parking lot. No gate, security barrier, or surveillance camera is visible in the photographs.
attachments.title: Loading Dock Photos

submitted_text:
I was traveling for work from January 15-22. My flight itinerary shows departure on January 15 (United UA1432 SFO→ORD) and return on January 22 (United UA891 ORD→SFO). I was not present at the delivery address during the delivery window.

Our office manager (who handles all deliveries for the suite) confirmed she has no record of a furniture delivery on January 19 or any other day that week. The loading dock is a shared area for the entire building (12 suites) and is not staffed or monitored.

Building management confirmed there are no security cameras covering the loading dock area. They have no delivery log system for the shared dock.
